utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the seventeenth. Can you all hear me? Teams is doing that thing with the microphone again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep. You're clearer than the heating in the portakabin, anyway. That thing's either tropical or completely off.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's the executive climate-control package, that is.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Try the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Cold room, no coffee. Living the dream.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, excellent morale already.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Still better than the football last night. I sat through all of it, more fool me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I turned it off. There's only so much suffering before an early shift.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Probably wise. Right, what's already out of the way?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the stretch wrapper yesterday. That's done, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that's showing complete on my side.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the line 2 last night. All finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, cheers for that. Shift handover had it down as complete as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One odd thing, though. I saw the pressure on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. You're reporting what you saw, not putting another job forward here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: heard a slight rattle from the Boiler Safety Relief Valve, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Just the observation, then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, we can't get to the AC1 until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And there isn't a production window available at the moment, no.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right. AC1 stays blocked, and that shutdown is cancelled, not something we're allocating today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Just keeping everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the booster pump by 11am. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The booster pump, yeah? Not the seals on the Water Booster Pump?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the booster pump pressure drop. Separate issue. I'll take that investigation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got you, Grace. Low priority, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Saz, can you do the pre-use checks on the trucks tomorrow at 9:30? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep—sorry, talking over you. Tomorrow at 9:30, not this morning?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, yes. Straight away at that slot, before use. That's the safety-critical one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks tomorrow at 9:30, straight away before use.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, the timing makes sense now. Your audio clipped a bit on 'tomorrow'.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Lovely. Right, the seals next.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump Monday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah on the Water Booster Pump seals, Monday, normal priority. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Two pump things, two separate issues. Easy to muddle those on a call.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll run a function test on the relief valve by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Function test only, is that what you're covering?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's right, the function test on the relief valve. I'll have that done by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah Price. That's yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can you grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 2, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 2 if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that's a fit-it-in one, rather than a timed deadline?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. If you've got a spare minute; no fixed deadline on that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine by me. Not pretending I've got three pairs of hands, but I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Marc, can you do a site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor by 11am? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, you went a bit robotic after Harbour Road. With the contractor?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, with the contractor, by 11am. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, agreed. I'll do the site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Harbour Road, Marc, by 11am. I've got that as important but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, spot on.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Hannah, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team this afternoon? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team this afternoon. Understood, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: This afternoon works from the shift side, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay. So I've got the toolbox talk this afternoon and the relief valve function test by end of day. Both fine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's right, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing else from stores. My only point was that rattle, and that's just information.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing else here either. Apart from apparently being dressed for the wrong climate in this cabin.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: At least you haven't got a cup of brown disappointment to go with it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And just so the old entries don't muddy things: AC1 still blocked, shutdown cancelled. Neither's back on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good, that's everyone. Thanks all. We can leave the coffee reviews there.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all. Bye.
